verdict.rationale: Letta clearly supports persistent memory across sessions (MemFS, /remember, stateful agents resumable across sessions/computers) and explicitly documents semantic search as an optional add-on via the 'MemFS Search mod' for keyword/semantic/hybrid search rather than a built-in default. Community commentary confirms the memory system is real and text/file-based but transparency-focused, not natively semantic-first, and some users raise unresolved concerns about memory scaling/self-improvement. missing for 10: first-party evidence that semantic search is enabled by default (not an optional mod), independent hands-on benchmarking of recall/retrieval quality, and clearer documentation of retrieval accuracy at scale.
